name: nyoa
description: NYOA — a real estate operating system for Claude. 27 AI skills built on the v0.6 architecture (workspace schema versioning, help system, hygiene tools). v0.8 adds /nyoa-3d-tour — vendor brief, DIY phone-scan checklist, hosting decision tree, embed snippets, and launch-day promotion package for photoreal 3D Gaussian Splat tours; light write-throughs in listing-copy, listing-presentation, buyer-seller-comms, and open-house pick up the tour URL automatically when present. v0.7 added the operations layer (contract deadlines, open-house promotion, monthly market updates), growth layer (touch cadence, database audit, neighborhood pages), bookkeeping (receipts, settlement, mileage), and template extensions to listing-audit (SEO/AEO site audit mode), listing-copy (carousel script + photoshoot brief), social-content (weekly planner + IG playbook), and buyer/seller comms (past-client birthday, home anniversary, closing-day note).
